name: Seed league
source: App league; judged from the recorded rosters and this league's own rules, never from MFL

rules.label: Starting position limits
rules.words: CB: 2 to 4; DE: 2 to 4; DT: 2 to 4; LB: 2 to 4; PK: Exactly 1; QB: Exactly 1; RB: 1 to 3; S: 2 to 4; TE: 1 to 3; WR: 2 to 5

rules.label: Starting group limits
rules.words: Defense: Exactly 12; Offense: At most 8; Total: Exactly 21

verdict.words: Invalid lineup: RB: 0 starting, needs at least 1; WR: 0 starting, needs at least 2; TE: 0 starting, needs at least 1; PK: 0 starting, needs exactly 1; DT: 0 starting, needs at least 2; DE: 0 starting, needs at least 2; LB: 0 starting, needs at least 2; CB: 0 starting, needs at least 2; S: 0 starting, needs at least 2; Defense: 0 starting, needs exactly 12; Total: 1 starting, needs exactly 21
verdict.penalty: The highest-scoring starter's points are set to zero
